description: Updates the collection_status of a specific accession test line item (distinct from sample_collection.collection_status - see notes).
validation: accessionTestId must exist and belong to organization + branch + accessionId
collectionStatus must be one of NOT_COLLECTED, COLLECTED, PARTIALLY_COLLECTED (CHECK)

errors.condition: collectionStatus missing or not a recognized enum value
accessionTestId not found / not in organization+branch scope

notes: accession_tests.collection_status (NOT_COLLECTED / COLLECTED / PARTIALLY_COLLECTED) is a distinct column from sample_collection.collection_status (COLLECTED / RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED / REJECTED, see API-072 in the Sample Collection module) - the two tables share a field name but different enums and different tables. Frontend/design consumers should not conflate them.
